Container.Name: Dualarr
Container.Overview: A companion to Sonarr for anime. Dualarr checks the audio and subtitle languages of every anime file Sonarr has, and keeps them in Japanese with subtitles: it flags files without Japanese audio (English-only dubs) or without subtitles, and replaces them in one click (blocklist, delete, search again). It also sets up two custom formats in Sonarr so subbed-only releases are upgraded to dual audio (Japanese + English) once the dub comes out, and dub-only releases are never grabbed. A nightly scan searches a few series at a time and can notify you (Discord, Telegram, ntfy, Gotify, webhook) about upgrades and problems. The first visit creates your login; then connect Sonarr and apply the custom formats from Settings.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: anime sonarr dual audio dub sub subtitles japanese custom formats
Container.Requires: Sonarr v4 with "Analyse video files" on (Settings → Media Management), so it knows each file's audio and subtitle languages.
Container.Changes: ### 0.1.0 (2026-09-28) - First release. - Checks every anime file's audio and subtitle languages from Sonarr's media info: dual audio, subbed, no subtitles, no Japanese audio. - One-click Sonarr setup: "Dual Audio" and "Dub Only" custom formats, scored in the quality profiles you pick. - Nightly scan with a paced search; Replace blocklists, deletes and re-searches files that break the rules. - Notifications (Discord, Telegram, ntfy, Gotify, webhook); login, API key for scripts.

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: Database (settings, login and the last scan). Keep it: everything you set up lives here.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as.

Config.Name: Reset login
Config.Description: Forgot the password? Set to true, start the container, create a new login in the web UI, then set this back to false. Settings are kept.
